detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Scam Line — a party game for 4–8 players

Only One Will Win

You are locked in a room. You cannot see the others. You can only talk through an old mobile phone.

Trust is optional. Survival is not.

About the Game

Scam Line is a multiplayer social game for 4 to 8 players where you compete in psychological and social challenges.

All players are placed in separate rooms. Communication is limited. Information is power.

In Early Access, the game features 22 social challenges, including:

• Learn your neighbours’ room numbers before anyone else

• Identify who is dressed differently

• Play the classic Prisoner’s Dilemma

• And many more…

Every challenge tests how well you can read people — and how well you can lie to them.

Play Your Way

There are no right choices. Only consequences:

• Form alliances

• Make deals

• Share information

Or choose a darker path:

• Bluff

• Lie

• Manipulate

In the end, only one of you will win.

Key Features

Social deception 4-8 players gameplay

Voice-based communication

Psychological mind games

Unpredictable player behavior

Simple visuals, strong atmosphere

FAQ

How much does the game cost?

  • About the price of a cup of coffee.

New social multiplayer games release every day - why this one?

  • Scam Line focuses on deception, timing, and environmental surprises to create a truly unique social experience. You are an architect of your gaming experience. Based on your behaviour every run may become a unique adventure.

Will it run on a potato PC?

  • Yes.

Are there bugs?

  • No.
